# Columns are TAB-separated: input, expected, shard.
# expected is the normalized path, or REJECT.
# shard is the two-hex shard id of the normalized path, or - if REJECT.
# A row whose input contains % is DecodeThenNormalize. Every other row is NormalizeManifestPath.
